Subject: Proposal: Proactive fallback credits & SLA unbundling for BrightCart

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As promised I attached a concise option that separates (a) response & on-call coverage from (b) failover/region fallback guarantees. The intent is to give BrightCart the ability to pick best-effort failover credits when regional capacity is constrained without paying the full premium for 24x7 Tier 1 coverage everywhere.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Base SLA: 99.9% regional uptime across primary deployment (standard pricing)
- Priority lane (P1/P2) response add-on: 4-hour P1, 8-hour P2 response windows (priced per seat)
- Proactive fallback credits: when BrightCart triggers cross-region failover, credit applied to next bill as a % uplift (scaled by incident duration & tokens served)
- Unbundled failover region: optional standby region at reduced cost (cold warm boot with credits applied when used)

Why this is different: instead of one monolithic "premium SLA" we unbundle the economics so you only pay for what you need but still get a deterministic credit when we perform an elevated operational action for you.

Next steps: if this aligns, I can loop in pricing and legal to produce an SOW + a simple DocuSign to make it pilot-ready.

[Attachment: ProactiveFallback_Winback_v1.pdf (summary)]

Best,
Karthik

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. We've pulled together a short, procurement-friendly response and a sample calc (attached). Key points: 

1) Deterministic credit formula (example enclosed in the spreadsheet):
   - Credit = UpliftRate * TokensDuringFailover * EffectiveTokenPrice * (HoursImpact / 24)
   - Example: 25% uplift * 250,000 tokens * $0.0006/token * (3 / 24) = $4.69 (applied as invoice credit)

2) Credit treatment: invoice-level credit (we will issue a credit memo on the month following the incident). We can include a two-line accounting note in the SOW.

3) Standby region SKUs: 
   - Warm Standby: $1,200/mo — auto-boot + health check; RTO target 30 minutes; covered for failover credits when used.
   - Cold Standby: $250/mo — manual boot; no RTO guarantee; credits not applicable.

4) P1 response scope: initial triage + senior SE escalation for first 4 hours included in P1 seat. If BrightCart requests true on-call replacement (vendor-managed engineer assigned to your rota), that is an add-on priced per engineer.

5) Pilot offer: 3-month pilot with 25% uplift on failover credits, one Warm Standby at 50% list for first 90 days, and invoice-credit treatment. After pilot, uplift steps down to 15% unless usage patterns indicate otherwise.

Attachments: proactive-fallback-credit-model.xlsx (worked example and simple monthly price table), redlined SOW snippet placed into the Drive link below.
